name: J. P. Elverson
role: Depot telegraph operator; acting stage agent
mentions: J. P. Elverson resigned some time ago as night operator at the depot and W. H. Minty of Minneapolis now takes his place. A. D. Green has been transferred to New Rockford and G. G. Coop…
J. P. Elverson is now acting as agent for the stage company here, and S G. Smith, of Bismarck, as superintendent.
